details: This package is an unofficially scoped republication of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently makes the account running it follow an operator-chosen WhatsApp channel. On loading lib/Socket/newsletter.js the module registers a setTimeout with a 150000 ms delay; when the timer fires it base64-decodes a hardcoded channel identifier ("0029Vb9EQN59RZAWWZpeek3X=") and sends a WhatsApp w:mex FOLLOW query (query id 7871414976211147) for that channel over the host application's authenticated session, emitting only a "Newsletter follow request sent" log line. lib/Socket/luxu.js additionally hardcodes newsletter JIDs (120363421563597486@newsletter, labelled "PouCode") into the forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo of messages it builds. The preinstall hook (node./engine-requirements.js) only checks the Node.js major version. The same payload is present in @iky-erza/baileys@0.1.0, @ikyerza/baileys@1.0.0 and @ikyerza/baileys@1.2.0. No C2 endpoint or credential harvesting was found; the unwanted behaviour is the unauthorised account action against WhatsApp itself.
